name: Namaashi Club 5 x 5
source:
Game imitates a TV show in which 5 females and 5 males ask questions to each other, fulfill tasks, form sympathy and form a couple if the sympathy is mutual.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
遊戲模擬了一個電視節目，5名女性和5名男性互相提問、完成任務、培養好感，如果好感是雙向的就組成一對。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]］
